tips.text: Check whether your clan already researched the Kreska before spending Fieldron Samples; Energy Lab research is shared.
Start the 72-hour research first and gather materials while it runs.
Run the level 30-50 Fortuna bounties; they cover Fieldron, Spore, Thermal Sludge, Amarast and standing in one go.
Expect one to two Orb Vallis sessions plus whatever Corpus Samples you pick up on the side.
